change.after: "policy exceptions disabled by default; only allowed in a specified namespace"

of.needed: whether the installation explicitly enables policy exceptions and sets the allowed namespace; the controlling configuration key is not named in the evidence

consequence.statement: With the new defaults, policy exceptions are disabled and only allowed in a specified namespace, so existing PolicyExceptions are not honoured unless the operator restores the configuration per the upgrade guidance.
consequence.remediation: Follow the 1.13 upgrade guidance to explicitly enable policy exceptions and configure the namespace they may be created in.

assertion.statement: Kyverno 1.13.0 changes its defaults so policy exceptions are disabled and may only be created in a specified namespace (previously allowed in all namespaces, CVE-2024-48921); environments relying on PolicyExceptions must follow the upgrade guidance to keep them working.

proposal.undeterminedReason: subject: The evidence describes the changed default but does not name the Helm value, flag or config key that controls policy exceptions or their namespace.
